info.title: TravelMate AI Backend API
info.description:
REST API for TravelMate AI — travel planning, bookings, chat, RBAC, and platform services.

**Authentication:** Most endpoints require `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>` from `POST /api/auth/login`.

**Interactive docs:** When the backend is running, open [http://localhost:4000/api/docs](http://localhost:4000/api/docs).

**Default admin (dev):** `admin@travelmate.ai` / `Test1234`
